newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China GDP seen 10.3 pct in 1997 - paper.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China GDP seen 10.3 pct in 1997 - paper.

text.p: China's gross domestic product is expected to grow by 10.3 percent in 1997, the China Market Economic News said on Wednesday.
Officials have said they want to curb economic growth below 10 percent to keep the economy from overheating and have forecast economic growth in 1996 at about 9.8 percent.
The forecast said primary industry was expected to grow by 4.3 percent, compared with 4.6 percent in 1996.
Secondary industry would grow 13.4 percent, with heavy industry growing 13.6 percent and light industry 13.5 percent, it said.
It forecast growth of 8.2 percent for tertiary industry, with communications, transport and postal sectors growing 10 percent and commercial services growing 8.8 percent.
